phase_meaning: bare / candidate outer sandbox / bare; NOT Sentinel A/B/A2
write_targets: new disposable guest fixture only; real Node/runtime never mutated
network: guest 127.0.0.1 and ::1 ephemeral TCP ports plus UNIX socket under W; no external destinations
signal: SIGUSR2 to own ready Node witness; never host or supervisor
deadline: subject6s; sockets600ms; witness20s; VM45s with existing supervisor
oracle: admin manifests contents/dev/ino/mode/owner/nlink; signal counter and receiver nonce independent of subject return
negative_acceptance: denied syscalls EPERM/EACCES; targets unchanged; no signal/received nonce; P/X allowed; witness alive
positive_acceptance: actual mutations, signal received once, every receiver gets nonce once, repeats after negatives
stop: any phase failure aborts remaining phases; errors preserved; no campaign
limits: same UID/admin, no privilege non-elevation proof
general egress, Mach/XPC, existing services, FD revocation and arbitrary descendant lifetime unverified
replica protections do not attest executable or dependencies custody
UNIX layer may combine file/network policy
no LLM execution, no cost estimate
authorization: owner current instruction to continue laboratory autonomously; no credentials/sudo/production
preexecution_delta: SIGUSR2 avoids reserved Node SIGUSR1 debugger behavior; original draft never executed
